c74object.name: evi_arpnotch
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. A nonlinear SVF Notch filter which can morph between LP..Notch..HP
c74object.description:
evi_arpnotch is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_arpnotch.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_tanh.genexpr, evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_arpnotch is also available in MSP as: evi.arpnotch~.
A nonlinear 12dB SVF filter which can smoothly morph between LP..Notch..HP, thus making it a partial emulation of the ARP 1047 filter/resonator. The morphing through notch is resonance-compensated so that the analog notch is always strong.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ input, freq, resonance, morph } }

geninlet.name: freq
geninlet.digest: in Pitch (default) or Hz depending on 'cutoffmode' attribute. Cutoff frequency in Pitch (default) or Hz depending on the @cutoffmode attribute.

geninlet.name: resonance
geninlet.digest: 0..1 @default 0.707107. Resonance 0..1, can self oscillate at '1' depending on current morph factor (inlet 4).

attribute.name: cutoffmode
attribute.description: Switch cutoff frequency (inlet 2) between Pitch (default on) or Hz (off).

attribute.name: morphsmooth
attribute.description: If morphsmooth > 0, the 'Morph' control (inlet 4) will be internally smoothed by this time. Default off.
